snippet.title: Lawn Mowing Simulator 2: Diner - Concept vs In-Game!!
snippet.description:
Take a look how far the Diner in Lawn Mowing Simulator 2 has come since we began work on the project!

We've put together a blog post together for this if you want more of a deep dive! - https://tinyurl.com/y6frwa27

Want to name the Diner? Well you're in luck, check out our Diner reward tier on Kickstarter now! Only 1 person can name it... and it could be you!
